official_raft_guidance.title: FSSAI Handbook on Rapid Analytical Food Testing (RAFT), Volume 2.0 — method/kit validation guidance (05 June 2025)
official_raft_guidance.scope: Validation criteria for methods/kits seeking FSSAI RAFT scheme approval; not a new mandatory metals manual, not laboratory accreditation, not an operative CTR limit

policy: Eight suggested supporting-evidence checks sit INSIDE pre-existing Batch44 LAB_MATRIX_METHOD_AND_LOQ and LOT_COA_AND_INDEPENDENT_SIGNOFF gates. They are NOT independent official legal mandates or 280 new sent requests. No test or release authority.

checks.label: Full procedure and source authority
checks.template: Obtain entire official method title, publication/version, page and regulator adoption or applicable laboratory method decision. Bare FSSAI 09.xxx numbers are unsafe where 2024 manuals disagree.

checks.label: As-sold matrix, processing and sampling
checks.template: Document the marketed food's actual formulation, preparation, dry/wet basis, fat/moisture and sampled form; demonstrate the lab method includes that exact matrix.

checks.label: Exact analyte and chemical species
checks.template: Identify the legally relevant analyte and (where relevant) chemical species and reporting basis. Do not silently substitute total element for species-specific limit.

checks.label: Selectivity and matrix interference
checks.template: Obtain analytical specificity evidence, target versus interference, and matrix-specific suppression/enhancement assessment.

checks.label: Calibration and reportable range
checks.template: Obtain dated traceable calibrator/standard details, linear or justified calibration model and a validated concentration range encompassing the legally reviewed action level.

checks.label: Matrix-specific LOD and LOQ
checks.template: Obtain actual laboratory/matrix LOD, LOQ, units and raw validation basis; compare LOQ to a separately signed applicable CTR maximum only after legal scope is established.

checks.label: Recovery, blanks, precision and uncertainty
checks.template: Obtain method and reagent blanks, matrix spike/CRM where suitable, recovery, replicate precision, carryover assessment and documented uncertainty appropriate to the procedure.

checks.label: Lab accreditation, CoA and lot trail
checks.template: Obtain exact laboratory accreditation scope for method/analyte/matrix, report signatory, sample collection and chain of custody, lot identity, signed results and separate legal reviewer sign-off.
